create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with a specified start node for building a finite state transducer
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional start and accept flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw a gtn Graph and export it as a PDF with symbol labels
union_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
